caption: The drawing depicts two main objects: a human figure and a castle tower structure. The human figure, situated on the left side, is dressed in a Renaissance-style outfit consisting of a red hat with a feather, a red and black tunic, yellow puffed shorts, yellow stockings, and brown boots. The figure has a mustache and is holding a large rifle-like firearm with both hands, aimed towards the right. The base on which the figure stands is green and textured. On the right side, there is a beige stone-like castle tower with visible brick details, featuring two vertical sections with narrow windows or slits. At the base of the tower is another smaller human figure wearing a red top and yellow shorts, standing on the green platform and partially attached to the tower, as if emerging from a doorway or hanging on the wall. The colors used predominantly are red, yellow, black, green, beige, and a muted gold for details. The drawing is composed on a plain, off-white background without additional scenery or elements.
title: Mechanical Toy Bank
